title: Bright & Cute Blog Creator
description: A simple and visually appealing blog webpage that allows users to create blog posts with titles, descriptions, and image uploads. Designed for ease of use with a bright and cute aesthetic.

features.name: Create Blog Post
features.description: Allows users to create a blog post by entering a title, description, and uploading an image.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Enables users to upload images to accompany their blog posts without restrictions on file size, format, or resolution.

target_users: Individuals who want a simple and visually appealing platform to create and share blog posts.
data_requirements: Each blog post should store a title, description, and an associated image.
